patthana21.16:1.1: na dassanena pahātabbaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na dassanena pahātabbo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.16:2.1: na dassanena pahātabbaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na dassanena pahātabbaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na dassanena pahātabbo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā dve.
patthana21.16:3.1: na dassanena pahātabbaṃ na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. na na dassanena pahātabbaṃ na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā dve. nabhāvanāyapahātabbaduka nakusalattike bhāvanāyapahātabbaduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.16:4.1: na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na bhāvanāya pahātabbo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.16:5.1: hetuyā ekaṃ. nadassanenapahātabbahetukaduka nakusalattike dassanenapahātabbahetukaduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.16:6.1: na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na dassanena pahātabbahetuko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.16:7.1: hetuyā ekaṃ. nabhāvanāyapahātabbahetukaduka nakusalattike bhāvanāyapahātabbahetukaduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.16:8.1: na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.16:9.1: hetuyā ekaṃ. nasavitakkaduka nakusalattike savitakkaduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.16:10.1: na savitakkaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā savitakko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.16:11.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nasavicāraduka nakusalattike savicāraduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.16:12.1: na savicāraṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā savicāro kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.16:13.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nasappītikaduka nakusalattike sappītikaduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.16:14.1: na sappītikaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sappītiko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.16:15.1: hetuyā tīṇi. napītisahagataduka nakusalattike pītisahagataduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.16:16.1: na pītisahagataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā pītisahagato kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.16:17.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nasukhasahagataduka nakusalattike sukhasahagataduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.16:18.1: na sukhasahagataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sukhasahagato kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.16:19.1: hetuyā tīṇi. naupekkhāsahagataduka nakusalattike upekkhāsahagataduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.16:20.1: na upekkhāsahagataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā upekkhāsahagato kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.16:21.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nakāmāvacaraduka nakusalattike kāmāvacaraduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.16:22.1: na nakāmāvacaraṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nakāmāvacaro kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na nakāmāvacaraṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kāmāvacaro kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.16:23.1: hetuyā dve. narūpāvacaraduka nakusalattike rūpāvacaraduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.16:24.1: na rūpāvacaraṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā rūpāvacaro kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: .. narūpāvacaro kusalo dhammo ...
patthana21.16:26.1: na arūpāvacaraṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā arūpāvacaro kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: .. naarūpāvacaro kusalo dhammo ...
patthana21.16:28.1: na apariyāpannaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā apariyāpanno kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: .. pariyāpanno kusalo dhammo ...
patthana21.16:30.1: na niyyānikaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā niyyāniko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: .. aniyyāniko kusalo dhammo ...
patthana21.16:32.1: na niyataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā niyato kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: .. aniyato kusalo dhammo ...
patthana21.16:34.1: na anuttaraṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anuttaro kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: .. sauttaro kusalo dhammo ...
patthana21.16:36.1: na saraṇaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā araṇo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.16:37.1: na saraṇaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā saraṇo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.16:38.1: na saraṇaṃ na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā dve. nahetuduka navedanāttike hetuduka vedanāttikaṃ
